name: Banknote
description: A hard cut to a banknote. The speaker is the engraved portrait in the oval, still talking, drawn in green wavy lines that get thicker where the picture is dark. A big number types in digit by digit, with a title, a seal with the name, a red serial and a line of fine print.
when: When you say a money number or a result: revenue, a price, 'this course made 120,000'.
needs: the number, and the same number in words
the name and role on the seal
the serial and the fine print
the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
the engraving data (lum.js, made in the steps)
